period.saved.meaning: Confirms that a Period was added or its label, days or note were changed.

period.ended.meaning: Confirms that End today set a Period's last day to today.

period.removed.meaning: Confirms that a Period was removed.

period.conflict.meaning: Says a Period was not saved, ended or removed because it changed somewhere else first; the editor then shows the latest version.
period.conflict.text: This period changed elsewhere. Review the latest version before saving again.
